IM injection
The oral bioavailability of clozapine is about half that of the intramuscular injection
E.g. 50mg daily of the IM injection is roughly equivalent to 100mg daily of the tablets/oral solution. After
each injection has been given, the patient must be observed every 15 minutes for the first 2 hours to
check for excess sedation
NB: If IM lorazepam is required, leave at least ONE HOUR between administration of IM clozapine and IM
